answer: Locks are entered in zephyr, expire in fable, and quill lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 41 aliases therefore needs 35 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1425 identities would post 1301 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
